name: CommandBuffer
signature: public abstract partial class CommandBuffer : CommandBufferBase

docs.summary: Records GPU commands. Render context rents/begins/ends/submits it, not passes. Not thread-safe. Some commands need state bound first. Reset before reuse.

members.name: ResolveTexture
members.signature: public void ResolveTexture(Texture source, Texture destination)

docs.summary: Resolves multisampled texture into non-multisampled one.

members.name: ResolveTextureCore
members.signature: protected abstract void ResolveTextureCore(Texture source, Texture destination)

docs.summary: Resolves multisampled texture into non-multisampled one.

members.name: PushDebugGroup
members.signature: public void PushDebugGroup(string name, object? meta = null)

docs.summary: Pushes a debug group for grouping commands in debug tools. Nestable. Every push needs a pop.

params.name: Group name shown in debug tools.
params.meta: Object that tools capturing the commands receive with the group. Build it only when [`WantsDebugMeta`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.CommandBuffer~WantsDebugMeta).

members.name: WantsDebugMeta
members.signature: public bool WantsDebugMeta { get; }

docs.summary: True when a tool capturing the commands is listening, so group payloads are worth building.

members.name: PopDebugGroup
members.signature: public void PopDebugGroup()

docs.summary: Pops current debug group. Only after a matching push.

members.name: InsertDebugMarker
members.signature: public void InsertDebugMarker(string name)

docs.summary: Inserts a debug marker for spotting points of interest in debug tools.

params.name: Marker name shown in debug tools.

members.name: Draw
members.signature: public void Draw(uint vertexCount)

docs.summary: Draws with current bound state, no index buffer.

members.name: Draw
members.signature: public void Draw(uint vertexCount, uint instanceCount, uint vertexStart, uint instanceStart)

docs.summary: Draws with current bound state, no index buffer.

members.name: DrawIndexed
members.signature: public void DrawIndexed()

docs.summary: Draws indexed primitives with current bound state.

members.name: DrawIndexed
members.signature: public void DrawIndexed(uint instanceCount, uint indexStart, int vertexOffset, uint instanceStart)

docs.summary: Draws every index of the vertex source's index buffer with current bound state.

params.indexStart: Indices to skip in index buffer.

members.name: DrawIndexed
members.signature: public void DrawIndexed(uint indexCount, uint instanceCount, uint indexStart, int vertexOffset, uint instanceStart)

docs.summary: Draws a range of the vertex source's index buffer with current bound state.

params.indexStart: Indices to skip in index buffer.

members.name: DrawIndirect
members.signature: public unsafe void DrawIndirect(DeviceBuffer indirectBuffer, uint offset, uint drawCount, uint stride)

docs.summary: Issues indirect draws from buffer. Data must match IndirectDrawArguments layout.

params.indirectBuffer: Buffer to read. Needs IndirectBuffer usage flag.
params.offset: Byte offset to start reading. Multiple of 4.
params.stride: Byte stride between commands. Multiple of 4, bigger than IndirectDrawArguments.

members.name: DrawIndexedIndirect
members.signature: public unsafe void DrawIndexedIndirect(DeviceBuffer indirectBuffer, uint offset, uint drawCount, uint stride)

docs.summary: Issues indirect indexed draws from buffer. Data must match IndirectDrawIndexedArguments layout.

params.indirectBuffer: Buffer to read. Needs IndirectBuffer usage flag.
params.offset: Byte offset to start reading. Multiple of 4.
params.stride: Byte stride between commands. Multiple of 4, bigger than IndirectDrawIndexedArguments.

members.name: DrawIndirectCount
members.signature: public unsafe void DrawIndirectCount(DeviceBuffer indirectBuffer, uint offset, DeviceBuffer countBuffer, uint countOffset, uint maxDrawCount, uint stride)

docs.summary: Issues indirect draws whose count the GPU reads from a buffer, at most maxDrawCount. Needs GraphicsDeviceFeatures.DrawIndirectCount.

params.indirectBuffer: Buffer of IndirectDrawArguments. Needs IndirectBuffer usage flag.
params.offset: Byte offset of the first command. Multiple of 4.
params.countBuffer: Buffer holding the draw count as a uint. Needs IndirectBuffer usage flag.
params.countOffset: Byte offset of the count. Multiple of 4.
params.maxDrawCount: Upper bound on the draws issued.
params.stride: Byte stride between commands. Multiple of 4, bigger than IndirectDrawArguments.

members.name: DrawIndexedIndirectCount
members.signature: public unsafe void DrawIndexedIndirectCount(DeviceBuffer indirectBuffer, uint offset, DeviceBuffer countBuffer, uint countOffset, uint maxDrawCount, uint stride)

docs.summary: Issues indirect indexed draws whose count the GPU reads from a buffer, at most maxDrawCount. Needs GraphicsDeviceFeatures.DrawIndirectCount.

params.indirectBuffer: Buffer of IndirectDrawIndexedArguments. Needs IndirectBuffer usage flag.
params.offset: Byte offset of the first command. Multiple of 4.
params.countBuffer: Buffer holding the draw count as a uint. Needs IndirectBuffer usage flag.
params.countOffset: Byte offset of the count. Multiple of 4.
params.maxDrawCount: Upper bound on the draws issued.
params.stride: Byte stride between commands. Multiple of 4, bigger than IndirectDrawIndexedArguments.

members.name: Dispatch
members.signature: public void Dispatch(uint groupCountX, uint groupCountY, uint groupCountZ)

docs.summary: Dispatches compute with current bound state.

members.name: ComputeBarrier
members.signature: public void ComputeBarrier()

docs.summary: Makes earlier dispatches' writes visible to later dispatches of the same pass, for compute work that builds on itself inside one pass. The render graph orders passes, this orders dispatches within one.

members.name: DispatchIndirect
members.signature: public void DispatchIndirect(DeviceBuffer indirectBuffer, uint offset)

docs.summary: Issues indirect compute dispatch from buffer. Data must match IndirectDispatchArguments layout.

params.indirectBuffer: Buffer to read. Needs IndirectBuffer usage flag.
params.offset: Byte offset to start reading. Multiple of 4.

members.name: SetShader
members.signature: public void SetShader(GraphicsProgram program)

docs.summary: Sets active shader. Must match bound framebuffer/buffers. Merged properties stay bound; no need to reapply them.

members.name: SetComputeShader
members.signature: public void SetComputeShader(ComputeProgram program)

docs.summary: Sets active compute shader. Merged properties stay bound; no need to reapply them.

members.name: SetPushConstants
members.signature: public void SetPushConstants(ReadOnlySpan<byte> data, uint offset = 0)

docs.summary: Writes push constants, kept until overwritten and pushed to every later draw and dispatch whose program declares a block.

params.data: Bytes to write, a multiple of 4.
params.offset: Byte offset into the block, a multiple of 4.

members.name: SetPushConstants
members.signature: public void SetPushConstants<TData>(in TData data, uint offset = 0) where TData : unmanaged

docs.summary: Writes a value as push constants, see [`SetPushConstants`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.CommandBuffer~SetPushConstants).

params.data: Value to write, its size a multiple of 4.
params.offset: Byte offset into the block, a multiple of 4.

members.name: SetDescriptorTable
members.signature: public void SetDescriptorTable(uint set, DescriptorTable? table)

docs.summary: Binds a descriptor table to a set index for the following draws and dispatches, or unbinds it with null. Every program used while it is bound must declare that set with the table's layout.

params.table: Table to bind, null to unbind.

members.name: SetVertexSource
members.signature: public void SetVertexSource(IVertexSource source)

docs.summary: Binds vertex/index buffers and topology for next draws. Fully replaces old source.

params.source: Source to bind. Not null, pass an empty one for none.

members.name: SetProperties
members.signature: public void SetProperties(PropertySet properties)

docs.summary:
Merges properties into bind table, last write wins, sticks until ClearProperties or Begin.

No-op when the same set was applied last and is unchanged.

members.name: SetDefaultProperties
members.signature: public void SetDefaultProperties(PropertySet defaults)

docs.summary:
Merges defaults into the bind table without replacing any key already set through SetProperties.

Later SetProperties calls replace defaults, and a new defaults set replaces earlier defaults only.

members.name: ClearProperties
members.signature: public void ClearProperties()

docs.summary:
Clears all merged properties. No GPU calls.

Begin does this for you.

members.name: SetFramebuffer
members.signature: public void SetFramebuffer(Framebuffer fb, TargetLoadStoreOps? ops = null)

docs.summary: Sets render target framebuffer with load/store ops for the pass it starts. Defaults to load and store.

params.ops: Load/store/clear ops, or null for the ops the pass declared for it, else load and store. Explicit ops consume the declared ones.

members.name: SetFramebuffer
members.signature: public void SetFramebuffer(RenderTexture renderTexture, TargetLoadStoreOps? ops = null)

docs.summary: Sets render texture's framebuffer as render target.

params.ops: Load/store/clear ops, or null to load and store.

members.name: ClearColorTarget
members.signature: public void ClearColorTarget(uint index, Color clearColor)

docs.summary: Clears one color target inside the current pass. Index must be within framebuffer's color attachment count.

members.name: ClearDepthStencil
members.signature: public void ClearDepthStencil(float depth, byte stencil = 0)

docs.summary: Clears depth-stencil target inside the current pass. Needs a depth attachment.

members.name: SetFullViewport
members.signature: public void SetFullViewport()

docs.summary: Sets viewport to cover whole framebuffer.

members.name: SetViewport
members.signature: public void SetViewport(Viewport viewport)

docs.summary: Sets viewport.

members.name: SetScissor
members.signature: public void SetScissor(uint x, uint y, uint width, uint height)

docs.summary: Sets scissor rect.

members.name: SetStencilReference
members.signature: public void SetStencilReference(uint reference)

docs.summary: Sets stencil reference for subsequent draws. Applied from the program on SetShader.

members.name: SetBlendConstants
members.signature: public void SetBlendConstants(Color constants)

docs.summary: Sets blend constants for subsequent draws. Applied from the program on SetShader.

members.name: PushConstantCapacity
members.signature: public const int PushConstantCapacity = 128

docs.summary: Bytes of push constants a command buffer holds, the size every Vulkan device supports.
